E3415

The `{gate}` gate is denied by effective policy.

What

The `{gate}` gate is denied by effective policy.

Why

The shared policy ladder is the authority for audited escapes; an invocation gate cannot widen a `.Forbid` floor.

Fix

remove the gate or change the owning policy to allow it.
